SourceFiles.Header: Video files and image sequences to process:
SourceFiles.MeasureSizesTip: Measures the planet diameter in each file
SourceFiles.SortAscTip: Sort from smallest to largest object
SourceFiles.SortDescTip: Sort from largest to smallest object
SourceFiles.DeleteSelectionTip: Deletes checked files (or the active row if none is checked) - Del
SourceFiles.ColDiameterTip: Apparent planet diameter (median over a few frames)
SourceFiles.JoinMode: Join Mode (Merge all files into a single output)
SourceFiles.PresetsSubtitle: Automatically configures the tabs for the target type:
SourceFiles.PresetPlanetary: Planetary (Planet on black background: detection + centring + crop)
SourceFiles.PresetSolarLunarCloseup: Solar / Lunar Close-up (Surface: AFB anchor stabilisation)
SourceFiles.PresetSolarLunarFullDisc: Solar / Lunar Full Disc (Full disc: centring + histogram)
SourceFiles.PresetPlanetaryAnimation: Planetary Animation (Smooth centred MP4 / AVI video)

InputOptions.DebayerTitle: Raw File / Astro Camera Demosaicing (Colour Debayering)

ProcessingOptions.StabNone: No stabilisation (Keep the original video alignment)
ProcessingOptions.StabObject: Object / Planet Detection and Centring (Object / Planetary Detection)
ProcessingOptions.StabSurface: Surface Stabilisation by Anchor Box (Surface Feature Stabilisation)
ProcessingOptions.RejectNoObject: Reject frames with no detected object
ProcessingOptions.CenterObject: Centre the detected object in the frame
ProcessingOptions.ShowDetectedRed: Show detected pixels in red in the preview
ProcessingOptions.AutoRotate: Auto rotation (align ring orientation between files)
ProcessingOptions.AutoRotateTip: Detects the object's angle (e.g. Saturn's rings) in each file and automatically rotates the frames to align them with the first file in the list. Useful in Join Mode with videos taken at different angles.

QualityOptions.EnableQuality: Enable Quality Estimation and Selection (Enable Quality Estimation)
QualityOptions.ReorderFrames: Reorder frames from best to worst
QualityOptions.ReorderFramesTip: Disabled in Join Mode: videos are merged one after the other, in list order
QualityOptions.LimitBestFrames: Limit the number of best frames kept
QualityOptions.LimitFixed: Keep a fixed number of frames (Number of Frames)
QualityOptions.LimitPercent: Keep a percentage of the best frames (Percentage %)

AnimationOptions.ForwardPlay: Play frames in forward chronological order (Forward Play)
AnimationOptions.ReversePlay: Play frames in reverse after forward playback (Reverse / Back-and-forth)
AnimationOptions.RepeatCount: Number of repetitions of the complete sequence:

OutputOptions.FormatAvi: AVI - Standard video compatible with VLC, AutoStakkert! and RegiStax
OutputOptions.FormatMp4: MP4 - Universal MPEG-4 video compatible with VLC and all players
OutputOptions.FormatSer: SER - Lossless 8/16-bit astronomy format (SER Player / AutoStakkert!)
OutputOptions.KeepFps: Keep the source video frame rate (FPS)
OutputOptions.DefaultFolderHint: By default, a 'CassiniFlow_YYYYMMDD_HHMMss' sub-folder is created next to your source video.
OutputOptions.FolderWatermark: Leave empty to create the folder next to the source file...

Settings.CpuGroupDesc: Configure CPU thread allocation for multi-core decoding and encoding. You can allow CassiniFlow to utilize all threads of your processor.
Settings.WarningThresholdDesc: Displays a visual warning when the CPU allocation exceeds this threshold to prevent overheating and system unresponsiveness.
Settings.CpuInfoBox: CassiniFlow uses an optimized zero-allocation streaming engine. Utilizing all threads delivers maximum speed but generates increased thermal load.
Settings.ThemeGroupDesc: Choose CassiniFlow's default appearance. The Night Vision Red theme preserves night-adapted vision during telescope observation sessions.
Settings.LanguageGroupDesc: Select the user interface language. Changes take effect immediately.
Settings.AutoSaveNote: ✓ Your preferences are automatically saved to your user profile.
